newsitem.title: NORWAY: Swedish FinMin sees debt ratio falling quickly.
newsitem.headline: Swedish FinMin sees debt ratio falling quickly.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said on Tuesday that Sweden's debt ratio would fall quickly.
"We are banking on a balanced budget in 1998 and a surplus from 1999 onwards," Asbrink told reporters after a Nordic-Baltic finance ministers' meeting in Bergen.
"Then we will get a quick drop in debt ratio."
Asbrink was confident that Sweden would be able to meet all the Maastricht Treaty's convergence criteria this year.
"I am rather certain that we will meet the convergence criteria in 1997," Asbrink said.
